meaning:
ἁγιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἅγιος), [in LXX: 2Ma.15:2 * ;]
sanctity, holiness, regarded, properly, as an abstract quality (see next word, and cf. Lft. Notes, 49; MM, VGT, see word): 2Co.1:12, Heb.12:10.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
